The Field-Aggregation Transformer (FAT) is a shared attention mechanism that co-aggregates radiance and semantic-embedding fields by combining features from multiple reference views for a 3D point [S1].

The claim states that the Field-Aggregation Transformer (FAT) is a shared attention mechanism that co-aggregates radiance and semantic-embedding fields by combining features from multiple reference views for a 3D point. Source [S1] explicitly states in Section 4.2: 'we use shared attention (i.e. Field-Aggregation Transformer) to coaggregate the radiance field and semantic-embedding field.' It further details that for a position x in a novel view, it is projected to every reference image, and FAT is adopted to combine features from reference views for both the radiance field (Eq. 4) and the semantic-embedding field (Eq. 5). The notes also confirm that the same aggregation weights ($A_{FAT}$) are used for both fields, supporting the 'shared' and 'co-aggregate' aspects.
